review_method: Paired visual inspection of all 10 near-pair sheets, plus enlarged comparison of all 18 initially ambiguous pairs. Enlarged originals 26, 281, 134, 109 and 241 checked additionally. Does not approve labels.

7.reason: Worker at top right changes from bent over to standing; operator posture also changes.

22.reason: Standing people change leg/arm positions and partial occlusion at the image edge.

23.reason: Very similar seated-worker pose. Minor camera/scale variation remains; redundancy is not established strongly enough to exclude either image. Retain conservatively; not counted as confirmed useful variation.

24.reason: Different forklift framing and a partly visible person enters the right edge.

38.reason: Raised leg angle and person-to-machine overlap differ; framing also changes.

53.reason: Standing worker is present in one frame and absent in the other; forklift position differs.

61.reason: Forklift translates and the standing worker exits the right edge; changed occlusion.

62.reason: Forklift shifts and the person at the right edge changes position; preserve temporal variation.

75.reason: Background person raises arms; foreground pedestrian posture changes.

76.reason: Foreground forklift and carried pallet translate; pedestrian moves toward hand cart.

92.reason: Forklift/pallet and pedestrian positions differ noticeably.

97.reason: Forklift changes direction and is partly cut by the frame; major positional variation.

99.reason: Standing worker moves from the safety island toward the right walkway.

102.reason: Standing worker exits the right edge and forklift position changes.

103.reason: Standing worker moves from island to right edge; operator posture differs.

108.reason: Worker at right becomes more occluded/cut off; forklift translates.

109.reason: Worker at right changes position and visible extent; forklift shifts.

117.reason: Operator leans further forward in one frame; outside worker and forklift positions differ.

enlarged_visible_variation.25: Hand and leg positions differ in originals 26/281; retain both, labels still need correction.
enlarged_visible_variation.52: Originals 109/241 show different arm and upper-body posture; retain both.
enlarged_visible_variation.63: Originals 134/281 differ in posture and camera position; retain both.

remaining_reason: People, forklift, cargo or framing differ visibly in paired sheets. Preserve these candidate frames; this does not approve their labels.
ambiguous_reason: Small paired previews do not establish redundancy reliably. Preserve both until enlarged comparison; no automatic removal.
